signature_moves: Audio-anchored transcript reader: a 'Source Audio' player card paired with a word-synced inline highlight (amber current-word advancing with the scrubber) is the single decision that makes this a transcription app and not a notes app — the only place originality is spent

Correct two-level selection grammar: solid accent-blue knockout-white row in the focused list pane WHILE the sidebar shows a muted gray inactive-pane selection — the eye lands on exactly one row per pane (many clones wrongly paint both accent-blue)
Near-total Apple Notes/Mail shell adoption as a deliberate Jakob's-Law bet: instant familiarity over distinct identity
defects: Contrast Dilution (mild) — content-card hairline borders ~1.05:1 against white; player/body card edges are near-invisible (fails rubric #10 non-text >=3:1)

Toolbar action density (watch-item, not anti-pattern) — ~10 reader-toolbar actions above HIG's <=3 groups; trailing copy/star/share/export/search run blurs into one undifferentiated cluster; overflow or grouping would sharpen scent
Near-clone identity (taste note) — shell so faithful to Apple Notes/Mail the app has minimal visual identity of its own; 'competent but anonymous' on originality, defensible for a utility

aesthetic.direction: platform-default native productivity — inherits Apple's system chrome wholesale (SF Pro type ramp, controlAccentColor blue, vibrancy sidebar, capsule bezels) with zero brand overlay in the UI; the committed look lives only in the marketing cover, not the window. Not a range-map family — this is Neo-grotesque-adjacent by way of pure macOS convention
aesthetic.cluster_hint: apple-notes-shell native productivity (source-list + message-list + reader triad)

psychology: Jakob's Law — near-total adoption of the Apple Notes/Mail three-pane convention means zero learning curve; the dominant law the app exploits (be conventional about the interface, innovative about the product)
Von Restorff effect — the single accent-blue selected row is the one different thing per pane, so it is found pre-attentively; reinforced by binding accent to nothing else

Hick's Law / chunking — 35 transcripts chunked into 8 sidebar folders (All/Starred + 6 topics) keeps the decision at each level small; three-pane drill-down is progressive disclosure (folder -> list -> reader)
Serial-position effect — 'All Transcripts' and 'Starred' pinned at the top of the sidebar where recall is best
Aesthetic-usability effect — flawless native chrome raises the trust prior for an on-device-privacy pitch; the polish is the credibility
Recognition over recall — folder chips on list rows and the persistent 'Source Audio' player re-display context so the user never has to remember which recording a transcript came from
notes: The ONLY UI surface is the app window inside a 2000x1250 MARKETING COMPOSITE (cover.jpg): the teal/green sunburst backdrop and the glossy chrome-glass headline 'Transcribe All on Your Mac' are BRAND evidence, kept out of the app-UI tokens. No standalone screenshots, no dark-mode, no settings/empty-state/onboarding, no recording-in-progress state. Measurement is unusually trustworthy for a render because the traffic-light cluster (~72px) calibrates against the kit's 68pt spec => image-px ~ logical-pt; still marked (estimated) for possible resampling. Lineage is unambiguously native (high) — desktop density + control grammar leave no Catalyst/web ambiguity. Era classified liquid-glass on the strength of the capsule pop-up bezel and rounded content cards, but glass MATERIAL is NOT visually confirmed (flat light chrome) — recorded (insufficient-evidence) for glass per the humility rule; a flat-chrome native window with current-era geometry. Icon (white squircle + cobalt waveform, Big-Sur-era single-glyph-on-light-material) was NOT run through the icon rubric (task scoped to Workflow A only) — recorded as brand context. This is a high-fidelity native reference for the sidebar/list/reader triad and the correct two-level selection grammar; its taste value is convention-confirmation, not novelty.
